evidence: Text/Visual relation compatibility differs; mean normalized-operator relative-L1 is about 0.0159 Text and 0.0136 Visual; beta mean is 0.0526/0.0518.
limitation: Operator change is small and beta remains near initialization.
design_implication: Revise scorer to semantic-grounded relative compatibility while preserving raw-topology fallback.

evidence: Relation residual abs-mean is about 0.6714/0.6191; local adaptation c mean is about 0.0355/0.0316; edge support is unchanged.
limitation: Residual saturation and partial compatibility alignment remain parameterization concerns.
design_implication: Use R1-B and keep c for Stage-II relation-state conditioning.

evidence: Frozen relation-off changes fused embedding relative-L2 by about 0.0057 and prediction flip rate by about 0.0013.
limitation: This is frozen sensitivity, not retrained causal ablation; effect is small at the classifier output.
design_implication: Do not claim downstream utility from cosine alone; validate R1-B in P1.7.

evidence: P1 Full five-dataset validation mean is 0.8126 Accuracy and 0.7459 Macro-F1; no component-isolated R1 performance exists.
limitation: Full-model performance cannot identify R1 contribution.
design_implication: Performance is a guardrail, not the R1 selection criterion.

evidence: Corrected alpha means are about 0.1023/0.0997 with std 0.00173/0.00277; alpha cross-seed Pearson is about 0.563/0.603; term_p cross-seed Pearson is about 0.419/0.599.
scope: Text/Visual; 15 runs and same-node cross-seed pairs
limitation: Moderate consistency does not prove a better prior parameterization.
design_implication: Keep p but stabilize its scale and remove the weak c branch.

evidence: P1.5 covariance contributions of p/d/c are about 0.700/0.291/0.009 for Text and 0.992/0.005/0.003 for Visual; alpha has no 0/1 saturation.
limitation: Covariance contribution is descriptive and signed; it is not a causal decomposition.
design_implication: Use normalized projection p; retain rho_p and rho_d; delete explicit rho_c c.

evidence: No isolated frozen p intervention was run; corrected diagnostics show term_p rather than raw p is the stable functional quantity.
limitation: Missing direct intervention and retrained comparison.
design_implication: Add R2-specific diagnostics and matched P1.7 controls.

evidence: No R2-isolated performance evidence exists; P1 Full test mean 0.8091/0.7444 is descriptive only.
limitation: No test-based selection is allowed.
design_implication: Use validation guardrails in P1.7.

evidence: All Q/S/D/alpha banks have finite expected shapes; explicit S0...S3 are exported by the analysis API.
limitation: Shape/finite evidence does not prove utility.
design_implication: Keep unchanged.

evidence: S_k is formed recursively from P^m S_(k-1) with a reference to H0 and all states enter the retained bank.
limitation: No redesign is needed and no trajectory headline is warranted.
design_implication: Keep as progressive structure-semantic context formation.

evidence: Interaction-off changes downstream representations, while Stage-I banks remain defined independently of the intervention.
limitation: Intervention is not a causal ablation.
design_implication: Keep and test retained-context use in P1.7.

evidence: Mean context-change injection ratio is about 0.1692 Text and 0.1552 Visual; cosine to LayerNorm(S_k) is near zero but nonzero injection is present.
limitation: Directional cosine alone does not establish benefit.
design_implication: Keep current D/g_delta path.

evidence: D_k=LN(S_k-S_(k-1)) is added to hop tokens through g_delta W_delta with order embeddings.
limitation: One layer only; no evidence for deeper interaction.
design_implication: Keep unchanged.

evidence: Nodewise entropy is 0.4874/0.5551; node heterogeneity is about 0.4254/0.3605; query diversity is about 0.0680/0.0810; diagonal excess is near zero.
limitation: Mean-matrix entropy would overstate nodewise entropy.
design_implication: Freeze the node-adaptive interaction claim with corrected definitions.

evidence: Interaction-off changes fused relative-L2 by about 0.1860, cosine remains about 0.9812, and mean prediction flip rate is about 0.0476.
limitation: This is sensitivity, not retrained causal necessity.
design_implication: Keep one layer/one head and use the narrower node-mixture claim.

evidence: Eta is signed with negative fraction about 0.321 Text and 0.166 Visual; content and relation branches contribute to eta covariance.
limitation: Absolute amplitude alone is not branch contribution.
design_implication: Keep signed utilization but simplify the redundant reference branch.

evidence: gamma+DeltaGamma supplies the global and modality order baseline in the explicit eta reconstruction.
scope: Frozen V3 code and filter CSV
limitation: No isolated global-prior intervention.
design_implication: Keep.

evidence: delta_content is read from S_tilde and has larger eta covariance contribution than the reference branch.
limitation: Low-rank scorer utility is not isolated by retraining.
design_implication: Keep current low-rank content scorer; do not add a semantic-query scorer.

evidence: Reference residual follows an almost fixed [positive, negative, negative, negative] order pattern; node std is around 1e-4 while its mean dominates its absolute amplitude.
limitation: Small node std and low covariance do not prove harmlessness under a revised model.
design_implication: Remove from V3.1 rather than merely setting its scale to zero.

evidence: The residual re-injects centered [1,alpha1,...,alphaK] after alpha already formed S_k; P1.5 covariance contribution is near zero and slightly negative.
limitation: The branch could still interact after retraining, requiring a pilot check.
design_implication: Remove as redundant manual injection.

evidence: Relation residual abs-mean is only about 0.0039/0.0034, but relation-to-eta covariance contribution is about 0.239/0.318 and residual node std is about 0.00134/0.00130.
limitation: Small amplitude is not negligible node-variance contribution.
design_implication: Keep c_i-to-filter conditioning.

evidence: Text and Visual streams are tested independent until z_text/z_visual refinement and final concat fusion.
limitation: No cross-modal interaction is intended before fusion.
design_implication: Keep unchanged.

evidence: P1/P1.5 behavior was obtained without an auxiliary loss; no optimization pathology requiring one was identified.
limitation: Future training could reveal a distinct pathology.
design_implication: Remove from V3.1 design; revisit only after explicit evidence.

evidence: Corrected query diversity is nonzero but smaller than node heterogeneity; attention evidence supports node mixtures, not a strong relational hop claim.
limitation: Descriptive attention cannot establish reasoning semantics.
design_implication: Demote wording to Node-Adaptive Cross-Hop Context Interaction.

evidence: P1 Full is competitive descriptively but not uniformly superior to verified CoSI-MAG Final/All Plain across all datasets and metrics.
limitation: Test metrics are never used for selection; no component isolation exists.
design_implication: Treat performance as a guardrail for P1.7, not proof of every mechanism.
